mapper.update: update _volunteer_guide set voLocation = #{voLocation}, voTarget = #{voTarget}, voContent = #{voContent}, voCapacity = #{voCapacity}, voManager = #{voManager}, voContact = #{voContact} where guideId = 1

update _volunteer set voTitle = #{voTitle}, voLocation = #{voLocation}, voTarget = #{voTarget}, voContent = #{voContent}, voCapacity = #{voCapacity}, voManager = #{voManager}, voContact = #{voContact}, voStartDate = #{voStartDate}, voEndDate = #{voEndDate}, voRecruitStart = #{voRecruitStart}, voRecruitEnd = #{voRecruitEnd}, status = #{status} where voId = #{voId}
mapper.select: select v.voId, v.voTitle, v.voLocation, cast(v.voTarget as char(10000)) as voTarget, cast(v.voContent as char(10000)) as voContent, v.voCapacity, v.voManager, v.voContact, v.voStartDate, v.voEndDate, v.voRecruitStart, v.voRecruitEnd, v.recruitStatus, v.voRegDate, v.voUpdateDate, v.status, (select count(*) from _volunteer_apply where volunteerId = v.voId and status != 'CANCELED') as applicationCount from _volunteer v where v.voId = #{voId}

select v.*, (select count(*) from _volunteer_apply where volunteerId = v.voId and status != 'CANCELED') as applicationCount from _volunteer v where v.status = 'active' and v.recruitStatus = 'OPEN' order by v.voRegDate desc
limit #{start}, #{size}

select v.*, (select count(*) from _volunteer_apply where volunteerId = v.voId and status != 'CANCELED') as applicationCount from _volunteer v where v.status = 'active' and v.recruitStatus = 'CLOSE' order by v.voRegDate desc
limit #{start}, #{size}
select a.*, v.voTitle, v.voStartDate, v.voEndDate, v.voManager, v.voContact, v.voLocation, v.voContent from _volunteer_apply a join _volunteer v ON a.volunteerId = v.voId where a.voId = #{voId}
select count(*) from _volunteer_apply where volunteerId = #{volunteerId} and status in ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')

select case when timestampdiff(year, voBirth, curdate()) between 10 and 19 then '10' when timestampdiff(year, voBirth, curdate()) between 20 and 29 then '20' when timestampdiff(year, voBirth, curdate()) between 30 and 39 then '30' when timestampdiff(year, voBirth, curdate()) between 40 and 49 then '40' when timestampdiff(year, voBirth, curdate()) between 50 and 59 then '50' when timestampdiff(year, voBirth, curdate()) >= 60 then '60' end as agegroup, count(*) as count from _volunteer_apply where status != 'CANCELED' group by case when timestampdiff(year, voBirth, curdate()) between 10 and 19 then '10' when timestampdiff(year, voBirth, curdate()) between 20 and 29 then '20' when timestampdiff(year, voBirth, curdate()) between 30 and 39 then '30' when timestampdiff(year, voBirth, curdate()) between 40 and 49 then '40' when timestampdiff(year, voBirth, curdate()) between 50 and 59 then '50' when timestampdiff(year, voBirth, curdate()) >= 60 then '60' end order by agegroup
select dayofweek(voRegDate) as weekday, count(*) as count from _volunteer_apply where status != 'CANCELED' group by dayofweek(voRegDate) order by weekday

select v.voTitle as programname, count(va.voId) as applicantcount from _volunteer v left join _volunteer_apply va on v.voId = va.volunteerId where va.status != 'canceled' group by v.voId, v.voTitle order by applicantcount desc limit 10
select month(voRegDate) as month, count(*) as count from _volunteer_apply where status != 'CANCELED' and year(voRegDate) = year(curdate()) group by month(voRegDate) order by month
select sum(case when voExperience = 'Y' then 1 else 0 end) as experienced, sum(case when voExperience = 'N' then 1 else 0 end) as inexperienced from _volunteer_apply where status != 'canceled'
